1: # ARCHITECTURE — Full New Backend + Frontend Logic
2: 
3: Replaces the old tRPC + regex-decision + god-class backend. The system becomes:
4: 
5: ```
6: Browser (Next.js client, zustand stores)
7:    │  useChat (Vercel AI SDK @ai-sdk/react 4.x)
8:    ▼
9: /workspace/[threadId]   (client page, no full reload on threadId swap)
10:    │
11:    ▼  POST /api/chat (ChatTransport → streamText)
12:    │
13:    ├── live (fast) tools: askUserQuestion, showPlan, editPlan, memory tools,
14:    │                      HTTP request tool, media tools (image/transcription live)
15:    │
16:    └── durable (Anakin/Inngest) tools: delegateAgenticWork (one tool)
17:                │
18:                ▼  inngest.send("thread/run")
19:                ▼  Inngest fn "thread-runner" streams run_activities rows
20:                ▼  Supabase Realtime → ChatMessage updates live in place
21: ```
22: 
23: ## A. Auth (Supabase, Google only, MVP)
24: 
25: - Root `page.tsx` = login screen. `supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({provider:"google"})`.
26: - `onLinkIdentity`/redirect to `/workspace` after signup.
27: - Post-signup flow: pre-questions driven by a JSON config (role/usecase/goal,
28:   multi+single select; user edits the JSON, app maps it to QuestionFlow). Answers
29:   → `user_profiles.pre_answers`. If signup exists but profile row missing → auto
30:   navigate to onboarding (create on demand).
31: - `useSupabaseUser()` hook (zustand + Supabase client). Middleware/proxy
32:   (`src/proxy.ts` evlog) still runs; tRPC session shim removed — server routes
33:   read `createServerClient` session from cookies.
34: - Sessions: Supabase handles refresh (`@supabase/ssr` cookie-based). Server
35:   side: `createServerClient` with anon/publishable; protected route checks user.
36: 
37: ## B. Realtime plumbing
38: 
39: - **Supabase Realtime** on tables: `chat_messages`, `run_activities`,
40:   `approval_requests`, `notifications` (private channels, JWT-auth user filters).
41: - Client hooks: `useChatRealtime(threadId)` merges live broadcast rows into the
42:   chat store / useChat message list. **This is how Inngest-produced activity
43:   reaches the UI** (durable work streams to an open chat).
44: - Room id convention `thread:{threadId}` on Realtime channel.
45: 
46: ## C. Chat transport & message appending (the "no new message every tool" rule)
47: 
48: Streaming in web via `POST /api/chat` using `ChatTransport` protocol:
49: - Drive `messages` from DB via `chat_messages`, feed to `streamText`.
50: - **Live LLM path**: `streamText({model, messages, tools, toolApproval,
51:   stopWhen: isStepCount(maxSteps), system: composeSystem(workflow, plan, memory)})`
52:   → `toUIMessageStream` → `createUIMessageStreamResponse`. Returns typed
53:   `UIMessage` parts; `useChat`/`Chat` client keeps ONE assistant message alive
54:   and appends tool parts to it.
55: - **Durable path**: when a tool needs Inngest (Anakin, browser, sleep/schedule),
56:   the route/handler calls `inngest.send("thread/run", …)` and returns a
57:   "delegated" tool part with the `run_id`; UI shows ThinkingSteps derived from
58:   `run_activities` streamed in. When the run completes, the ChatMessage gets a
59:   final assistant part (result text). No new message bubbles for sub-steps —
60:   everything appends to the same assistant message.
61: - **New ChatMessage(assistant) triggers** ONLY: error, warning, workflow stops
62:   unexpectedly, user stops → user clicks Run again. (Per user rule.)
63: 
64: ```tsx
65: // client pseudocode — the appending contract
66: const { messages, sendMessage, addToolResult, stop } = useChat({ api: "/api/chat", id: threadId });
67: // useChat actually uses Chat/DefaultChatTransport — bridge in provider
68: ```
69: 
70: ## D. Tool surface (LLM-invocable, zod schemas, NEVER hardcoded)
71: 
72: | Tool | When | Runs |
73: |---|---|---|
74: | `askQuestion` | clarifying questions (any time LLM needs) | live — returns `AskUserQuestion[]` JSON → UI renders ask-user-questions (MCQ) |
75: | `showPlan` | ONLY when user explicitly asks to plan/workflow (NO auto-plan) | live — returns `{steps: [...], header}` → AccordionGroup |
76: | `editPlan` | add/remove/update any step | live — persists `plan_steps` |
77: | `finalizeAndInject` | user approves → bind thread↔workflow, set status | live + sends thread/run if "run" chosen |
78: | `bindWorkflow` (variant) | approve-but-not-run | live — bind only, workflow idle; Run button appears, Stop hidden. Run toggles→Stop while running |
79: | `storeMemory` / `searchMemory` | thread + global memory (mem0) | live (mem0 low-latency); ONE mem0 store per user, thread scoped by metadata |
80: | `httpRequest` | user bearer token, arbitrary HTTP | live — raw fetch; https-only, private-IP blocked, size/max-redirect caps |
81: | `delegateAgenticWork` | ANY Anakin capability (search/scrape/crawl/map/research/wire/browser + schedule) | durable → Inngest `thread/run`; returns run_id |
82: | `generateImage` / `transcribeAudio` | media generation requests | live when `IMAGE_MODEL`/`TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL` set per workspace/env |
83: 
84: - `askQuestion` → `AskUserQuestion` schema (packages/ui
85:   `ask-user-questions.tsx:37`) — single zod schema shared server+client.
86: - Auto-approve switch: toolApproval config + `approval_requests` row status
87:   auto-"approved" when workflow.auto_approve; system message emitted
88:   "auto-approved via settings".
89: - **NO auto-plan/wiring**: LLM answers plain text, never auto-creates a plan or
90:   binds a workflow on its own. `showPlan` only fires after user explicitly asks
91:   ("create a workflow / plan this"). A 2nd user message is NOT a plan trigger.
92: - **Attachments → LLM-readable**: image/pdf/video dropped into ChatComposer get
93:   converted to LLM input parts (image → data URL / base64 image part; pdf →
94:   extracted text part) before the call; media tools return real content.
95: 
96: ## E. Durable execution (Inngest): `thread/run`
97: 
98: - ONE event: `thread/run` (down from pile). `thread-runner` function:
99:   1. fetch everything from DB (thread, plan, memory summaries, previous runs).
100:   2. `generateText`/`ToolLoopAgent` with the SAME tool set minus the durable
101:      re-delegation (no recursion);
102:   3. persist each step/tool into `runs` + `run_activities` + broadcast.
103:   4. sleep/resume via `runs.status=sleeping` + schedule-tick (FIXED: add proper
104:      Inngest `triggers: [{ event:... }]` or `cron`) — and register ALL functions
105:      in `apps/web/src/app/api/inngest/route.ts` serve list.
106:   5. notify on completion/failure → `notifications`.
107: - Idempotency: `runs.status` gate `pending→running` with `select … for update`
108:   in Postgres; retries honor existing activity instead of re-running.
109: - Cost caps: check BEFORE each step (realtime), not after the run (fix the
110:   old post-hoc bug).
111: 
112: ## F. Frontend state (zustand)
113: 
114: - Zustand stores (each `[thread]`, `[sidebar]`, `[chatComposer]`, `[ui/theme]`,
115:   `[auth]`) — keeps server components pure; zustand used max; no useState sprawl.
116: - `threadId` navigation: Next.js `router.push('/workspace/'+id, { scroll:false })`
117:   updating only param; page reads `params.threadId` once → store. ChatComposer
118:   layout: centered when no messages → bottom once first message exists.
119: - ChatComposer: queue (ordered, editable, removable, durable-backend),
120:   token-quality slider formula: `maxTokens per CHAT request` (this is what the
121:   slider means; maps to `streamText.maxOutputTokens`, not a run budget),
122:   file/image/pdf attach → compress (canvas, WebP, quality 0.8, max 2000px) →
123:   Supabase Storage → `files` row + `UIMessage` attachments.
124: - Queue `chat_messages.status=queued`: on run finish, drain SEQUENTIALLY —
125:   deliver message, wait for that response to finish, then next (no parallel
126:   queue burst). Edited/reordered queue → DB rows updated in place, order kept.
127: 
128: ## G. Memory (mem0, ONE place per user, thread-scoped)
129: 
130: - ONE mem0 store per app user (as chosen): every thread's memories live there,
131:   scoped by `metadata.threadId`. `storeMemory`/`searchMemory` tools:
132:   - thread scope: `{scope:"thread", threadId}` — memories only reprompted for
133:     that thread.
134:   - global scope: `{scope:"global"}` — **program-given memory injected
135:     beforehand**, works across ALL workspaces/threads/apps for that user (not
136:     per-workspace). E.g. capability schemas, user prefs, standing instructions.
137: - `packages/agent/src/adapters/README.md:1` resolution: adapter schemas exposed
138:   to LLM via GLOBAL memory (per decision) — one tool `listCapabilities` returns
139:   schemas; keeps them OO-reflectable.
140: 
141: ## I. Permission model — invites, roles, sharing (locked answers)
142: 
143: ### Role set (ONE model everywhere)
144: `owner | editor | viewer` — **no admin**. | Action | owner | editor | viewer | thread-guest |
145: |---|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|
146: | rename / delete workspace, keys, settings | ✅ | — | — | — |
147: | manage members (invite/role/remove) | ✅ | — | — | — |
148: | create / rename / delete groups & threads | ✅ | ✅ | — | — |
149: | edit plans, bind workflows | ✅ | ✅ | — | — |
150: | send msgs, run/stop, approve approvals | ✅ | ✅ | — | ✅ |
151: | view history / runs / plan | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
152: | rename / rebind / re-share / delete shared thread | ✅ | — | — | — |
153: > thread-guest = the person invited to a SPECIFIC thread (thread share). Editor
154: > = member of the shared workspace.
155: 
156: ### Workspace invite (join the REAL workspace)
157: 1. Owner (only) copies workspace invite link / shares by email → `invites` row
158:    (`kind=workspace`, role editor|viewer chosen at invite).
159: 2. Invitee accepts → `workspace_members` row (role as invited). NO copy, no new
160:    workspace — it's the owner's actual workspace. Workspace appears in the
161:    invitee's top-left switcher (badge on the button) → switching in shows ALL
162:    groups + threads (all members see everything).
163: 3. Members chat/run using the **workspace's keys** (owner pays) UNLESS profile
164:    toggle "use my own keys in invited workspaces" is on → member's own
165:    workspace keys are used. `get_workspace_key` RPC + key-service honor this.
166: 4. Owner can change roles / remove / revoke anytime. Editor can delete any
167:    thread/group (even others'). Viewer read-only.
168: 
169: ### Thread share (guest in YOUR sidebar)
170: 1. Owner toggles `threads.share_enabled` and copies the thread share link
171:    (per-thread; the "list of my threads + switch" UI in Members/Share).
172: 2. Invitee accepts → `thread_shares` row. The LIVE SAME thread (not a copy)
173:    appears in the invitee's OWN workspace sidebar under the **INVITES system
174:    group** (created locked+empty at signup; only fills via accepted invites),
175:    with a Badge on the thread button and on the header. Both users
176:    chat in the same realtime thread.
177: 3. Invitee's messages use **their own keys**; their name shows on user bubbles.
178: 4. Owner revokes by flipping share_enabled / deleting the share.
179: 
180: ### Keys resolution order (chat / run)
181: ```
182: 1. member in a shared workspace + prefer_own_keys_in_shared=true
183:       → member's OWN Personal workspace keys (type: groq|anakin|mem0|…)
184: 2. workspace keys (the workspace the thread belongs to)
185: 3. env defaults (ANAKIN_API_KEY / GROQ_API_KEY / MEM0_API_KEY / models)
186: ```
187: 
188: ## J. Packages map (rewrite targets)
189: 
190: | Package | Old | New |
191: |---|---|---|
192: | `@aevryn/auth` | better-auth | Supabase client + SSR + google + onboarding trigger |
193: | `@aevryn/api` | tRPC router | dropped for chat (chat = `POST /api/chat`); keep minimal health/metadata route if needed |
194: | `@aevryn/agent` | runtime + registry + regex | `runAgent` live (streamText), durable `thread-runner`, tools from schema library |
195: | `@aevryn/workflow` | god service 66 methods | split: thread-service, plan-service, run-service, activity-service, notification-service, key-service, **member-service** (invites, roles, shares) |
196: | `@aevryn/inngest` | 3 functions, 1 served | serve ALL fns; `thread-runner` + `schedule-tick` (Inngest cron) + notify |
197: | `@aevryn/db` | 16 tables legacy | new SCHEMA.md (17 tables) + Supabase migration |
198: | `@aevryn/env` | server only | server + web split, USER keys via DB Vault (see ENV.md) |
199: | `@aevryn/ui` | components (keep) | real-data wiring (dropdown, nav, dialogs), ChatMessage attachments, ProfileDialog, Toaster mount |
200: 
201: ## K. Flow verification scenarios (must "just work")
202: 
203: 1. **"Hi"** → user text only, LLM plain text, NO tool call, NO new workflow.
204: 2. **"plan me a laptop comparison"** → LLM askQuestion (MCQ) → user answers →
205:    showPlan accordion → workflowApproval (approve/decline/bind/run) → bind →
206:    `thread/run` → ThinkingSteps stream research/scrape sub-tasks into the SAME
207:    assistant message → final answer text appended.
208: 3. **"scrape X.com profile" (no plan)** → delegateAgenticWork → durable run →
209:    run_activities stream → final text in same message.
210: 4. **user closes tab mid-run** → run continues in Inngest; reopening
211:    workspace reloads `chat_messages` + `run_activities` → renders state.
212: 5. **queued "delete workflow" while run active** → message queued durable;
213:    once run completes → queued delivered SEQUENTIALLY (wait each).
214: 6. **auto-approve ON** → approval resolves instantly + system message.
215: 7. **workspace invite** → invitee opens link, accepts → workspace in switcher
216:    (badge), ALL threads visible, chats charge workspace keys (owner) unless
217:    invitee's "use my own keys" toggle → own keys.
218: 8. **thread share** → owner toggles share, guest accepts → SAME live thread in
219:    guest's INVITES group + header badge, guest chats with OWN keys + name on
220:    bubbles, cannot edit plan/rename; owner revoke removes access instantly.
221: 9. **deleted thread** → soft-archive 30 days (trash), recover → live;
222:    after 30 days hard-delete (incl. runs/activities/files).
223: 10. **"re-run last run"** → play a rerun (trigger=rerun) with same plan, no
224:     new chat; hits new `runs` row, streams activities again.
225: 11. **first message** → auto-titles thread; title editable after.
226: 
227: ## L. Non-goals / pinned decisions
228: - Markdown rendering: FUTURE (write API to be parser-friendly — parts, no
229:   prose-heavy gating). Output contract ready for it.
230: - Media generation: IMAGE + TRANSCRIPTION SHIPPED in MVP (lazy-load provider
231:   when `IMAGE_MODEL`/`TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL` configured); SPEECH/VIDEO stay schemas
232:   only until models exist. Attachments always converted to LLM-readable parts.
233: - Sub-agents in parallel: FUTURE phase (see FEATURES.md); design tool outputs as
234:   containers so sub-agent results merge into `run_activities`.
235: - Creating MULTIPLE owned workspaces: FUTURE (pro tier). MVP = 1 owned
236:   Personal + unlimited JOINED workspaces (via invite).
237: - Shared-thread plan editing by guests: OFF (owner/editor only).
238: 
239: ## Product features (locked in docs; see NOTES "Decisions" & PLAN.md)
240: 1. **Soft-archive delete**: deleting a thread/workflow sets `threads.deleted_at`;
241:    recoverable 30 days (trash), then hard-delete incl. Storage. Never silent.
242: 2. **Smart auto-title**: thread title automatically set from the first user
243:    message (truncated); rename still available. No blank "New thread".
244: 3. **One Run mental model**: Run button AND the LLM both fire `thread/run`
245:    (same event). WorkflowApproval dialog = max 4 buttons: Approve+Run /
246:    Approve / Decline / Edit plan. No dead dropdowns.
247: 4. **Model presets**: Agent/Env tab shows a per-provider list of known model
248:    ids (searchable) + free-text override; picks write `workspace_api_keys.model_name`.
249: 5. **Share preview page**: share link lands on a preview (thread title + owner
250:    name only, NO content) with Accept — content stays private until accepted.
251: 6. **Export/import thread**: single JSON (plan + steps + key messages,
252:    keys stripped) for export/import — template/reuse path.
253: 7. **Re-run**: from a past Run play a rerun with the same plan, no new chat
254:    (`runs.rerun_of`, trigger=rerun).

100:   `PERSONAL` workspace and future ones. Thread-level is pointless UX (user
